quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026: net sales JPY 136,821 million (+11.5% YoY); operating profit JPY 3,369 million (-9.9%); ordinary profit JPY 2,094 million (+33.5%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 2,367 million (up JPY 2,330 million). quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states that continued data-center investment led by major US IT companies, and the introduction of next-generation GPUs for AI servers with rising power consumption, are expected to expand demand for power-supply components; the group is strengthening production capacity for large aluminum electrolytic capacitors, mainly for AI-server power supplies, continuing development and capacity-increase investment in high-capacitance, high-output hybrid capacitors, and developing a next-generation high-capacitance top foil. The company expects fiscal 2026 (the year ending March 2027) to be in supply shortage due to a demand surge, and does not expect price declines from price competition.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's review of the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026: in ICT, strong data-center investment by major US IT companies continued and demand for AI servers and peripherals expanded; automotive recovered moderately overall (BEV growth slowed by US policy changes, AD/ADAS advancing); industrial equipment showed signs of bottoming. The company focused on expanding sales of large aluminum electrolytic capacitors and hybrid capacitors to the fast-growing AI-server market, increased large aluminum electrolytic capacitor production capacity to meet server-related demand, opened a new sales office at US subsidiary United Chemi-Con Inc. and established an Indian sales subsidiary, Chemi-Con Electronics (India) Pvt. Ltd.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 totaled JPY 5,911 million: capacitors JPY 5,846 million, mainly expanding production equipment for aluminum electrolytic capacitor electrode foil and for aluminum electrolytic capacitors; other JPY 65 million. Planned new facility: capacitor manufacturing equipment at Chemi-Con Higashi Nihon (Yabuki, Fukushima), planned investment JPY 766 million (JPY 54 million already paid), started October 2025, completion planned November 2026, raising capacity by 61% on completion.
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 5,911 million; Yabuki plan JPY 766 million, completion November 2026, +61% capacity

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (expenses JPY 3,892 million; capacitors JPY 3,566 million, other JPY 325 million): developed the KHR series snap-in aluminum electrolytic capacitors for server power supplies for the AI-server market, with lengths up to 100mm for the growing number of server power designs that mount capacitors of 70mm or taller horizontally, about 25% higher capacitance on average than same-size conventional products; added new rated-voltage conductive-polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors for the 48V DC power distribution widely adopted in AI servers; developed the HXG series hybrid capacitors (smaller, higher power, higher heat resistance) for motor-drive inverter circuits in electric power steering and electric brakes; pursued DLCAP electric double-layer capacitors for backup use in automobiles and AI data centers; developed the FX series common-mode choke coils with what the company calls industry-best permeability, and the ML series CMOS camera modules for a next-generation high-speed transmission standard.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 3,892 million; KHR up to 100mm, about 25% higher capacitance; 48V hybrid capacitors

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company plan: the 11th medium-term management plan (the company's fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028; its fiscal 2026 is the year ending March 2027) started, with the aluminum electrolytic capacitor business at its core. In the growth markets, AI servers and automotive, high-performance, high-quality aluminum electrolytic capacitors are the focus products and the company aims to win stable orders through design-in activity; in the price-competitive mass (general-purpose) market it will pursue cost-structure reform (optimal-location production and material procurement, logistics and inventory management, transfer of production overseas, use of external aluminum foil for general-purpose products) and strategic sales to regain share. ROE and ROIC are its key management indicators.
